title: caprifolium italicum var. album
intro: Caprifolium italicum var. album, commonly known as White Italian Honeysuckle, is a plant species in the family Caprifoliaceae, characterized by its white, fragrant flowers and climbing habit. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of White Italian Honeysuckle include its ability to act as an antispasmodic, sedative, and anti-anxiety agent, making it useful for treating conditions such as insomnia, anxiety, and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenes, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
